2. Los Angeles, amenities: ["Playground", "Running Track"]
3. Chicago, amenities: ["Tennis Court", "Playground"]

We should output the function calls. According to the instruction, we should not provide additional text. Just the function calls. So we will produce three function calls.

Thus:

{
  "location": "New York City, NY",
  "amenities": ["Tennis Court", "Picnic Area"]
}

Similarly for others.
